title: How do I reinstate a suspended Pro Shop Store Credit account?
content:
## Applicable situation
This entry covers lifting a fraud-review hold on a member's Pro Shop Store Credit account and returning it to active status, together with any reinstatement fee charged at that moment.

## How it is invoked
Reinstating the account is carried out through an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call): reinstate_suspended_credit_account_88623c40. The representative prices any reinstatement fee before making this call.

## Parameters
- credit_account_id: the store-credit account's own reference number, reachable by looking up the member's store-credit account before the call.
- reinstatement_fee_amount: the dollar amount of the reinstatement fee to charge, in USD, with exactly two decimal places, already rounded to the cent; the representative passes 0.00 when no fee applies.

## Return
A successful call returns a confirmation naming the account's own reference number, its new status, and the fee amount charged (0.00 when none). A status of active in that confirmation is how the representative knows the hold was lifted; a fee transaction reference appears in the confirmation whenever the charged fee is greater than zero.
